title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
before: Frontier training was assumed to cost hundreds of millions of dollars.
problem: Export controls limited Chinese labs to slower H800 GPUs, so efficiency was forced rather than chosen.
breakthrough: 671B parameters with 37B active, combining latent attention and fine-grained MoE, trained in 2.788M GPU-hours.
why: Frontier-class results at a reported 5.576 million dollars for the final run. Note that figure excludes all prior research and failed runs.
next: R1 was built on this base a month later and reset expectations about open reasoning.
inherits: The efficiency-first frontier model, and a permanent argument about training costs.
